title: Cubic twisted sections from nontrivial order-three Prym line bundles on a smooth quadratic spectral cover
author: Nigel J. Hitchin
work: A Note on Coupled Dirac Operators
source_version: Official SIGMA 19 (2023) article 003, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2023.003; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a cubic section through the maximal isotropic filtration of the pulled-back rank-two spectral bundle. It represents the extension class near the ramification divisor by a Dolbeault quotient, uses divisibility by the tautological coordinate to remove the lifting obstruction, and proves uniqueness through the cohomology of the filtration. That uniqueness supplies the involution invariance needed to descend the constructed section to the base curve.
